scope: Original instruction observations, not native test pass results. CRC/guards and frame envelopes execute original code; protobuf uses original embedded schema via Python, not the C++ parser. Refcounts, address matching, delegates, final network I/O and sample-queue containers are doubles. FEC duplicate corruption is an observation, not required safe behavior.

defaults.object_memory: zeroed unless specified; original connection constants initializer runs

mtu.parsing: Python original-schema ParseFromString plus IsInitialized; C++ layout injection; real frame constructor and dispatcher

send_budget.transport_send: records final CRC-appended wire then returns input.transport_result

fec_ingress.byte_vector: steam-fec-reference.json; synthetic shard size 32, not runtime MTU policy

reliable_retry.last_send: input.last_send if present (including zero), otherwise default now-input.age_ticks
reliable_retry.socket_send: record attempt, returns success; timed-path cases stamp default now

timestamp.ping_and_offset_samples: capture only; container expiry and means excluded
timestamp.offset_sample_encoding: uint32 bits representing signed int32 ticks

control_actions.parsing: Python original-schema required-field validation; C++ layout injection

transport_lease.comparison: last receive and no repeated handshake; channel/delegate lookup are doubles
